facts.fact: Orange Botswana opened a data centre at the Botswana Digital and Innovation Hub science park in Gaborone, after a reported $5.2m investment; the document gives no date beyond its own (2023-12) and says the telco launched it.

Orange Botswana's Gaborone data centre is described by Orange as an Uptime-certified Tier III facility, billed as the first Tier III in Botswana (operator statement, reported by SDxCentral; date is the article's).

systems.system: Government-owned Tier IV data centre, Gaborone
systems.tiers: Tier IV listed by Uptime per article; not stated to rent to others
